name: agents-comm-bus-claude
description: Universal agent communication bus for Claude Code. One plugin per supported comm (Telegram, Discord, Matrix; Slack to follow). Each plugin bootstraps the per-user agents-comm-bus daemon and registers its comm adapter.

plugins.name: agents-comm-bus-telegram
plugins.description: Telegram messaging for Claude Code through the agents-comm-bus daemon. Send messages and attachments, receive inbound, route permission prompts and AskUserQuestion choices to inline keyboards.

plugins.name: agents-comm-bus-discord
plugins.description: Discord messaging for Claude Code through the agents-comm-bus daemon. Gateway inbound + REST outbound: send messages and attachments, receive inbound, route permission prompts and AskUserQuestion choices as text.

plugins.name: agents-comm-bus-matrix
plugins.description: Matrix messaging for Claude Code through the agents-comm-bus daemon. Client-Server /sync inbound + outbound: send messages and attachments, receive inbound, route permission prompts and AskUserQuestion choices as text.

plugins.name: agents-comm-bus-curl
plugins.description: Local HTTP ingress for Claude Code through the agents-comm-bus daemon: POST context from cron, CI, or scripts straight into the session.
